steps.name: Start simulator preview
steps.goal: Tap Start simulator in the preview card once. Wait for Stream A ready.
steps.done: The actual native preview card contains the loaded simulator page.

steps.name: Keep input during token renewal
steps.goal: Tap Tap preview inside the simulator page once. Then inspect only until Token renewal passed appears. Do not tap again.
steps.done: At least four status tokens were issued, the page loaded once, and its tap state survived.

steps.name: Replace the stream
steps.goal: Tap Replace simulator stream once. Wait for the new simulator page.
steps.done: A new stream ID loads one new document with fresh input state.

steps.name: Return to web preview
steps.goal: Tap the Web level tab under the simulator page once.
steps.done: Leaving the simulator returns the actual card to its usable web preview.
